item.title: AA Edit | SC Order Reveals EC Trust Deficit
item.description: The judicial officers will now adjudicate claims and objections of the persons put on the “logical discrepancy” list, a job that would otherwise have been done by officers nominated by the EC

item.title: AA Edit | Trade Deal And Tariffs Unclear For India As Trump Defies SC
item.description: The court’s decision to invalidate many of Mr Trump’s tariffs raised questions about what would become of all the agreements struck with major trading partners and the one on the anvil with India that was touted to be the “father of all deals” and was close to obtaining signatures on the dotted line after final consultations

item.title: Devi Kar | Can We Enhance Human Qualities As Machines Get ‘Smart’ In AI Era?
item.description: It is ironical that when parents come to admit their kids, they maintain that their first priority is that their children should grow up to be “good human beings”. Though curious, I refrain from asking for their definition of “good”. However, as time passes, I see that parents become extremely competitive and performance-conscious

item.title: Bharat Bhushan | Pax Silica: Insurance At The Cost Of Strategic Autonomy
item.description: India’s enthusiasm to join Pax Silica reflects its need to strengthen the resilience of its supply chains, reduce investment risks and build capacity. India gains access to secure supply chains, strengthening its semiconductor and AI ecosystems by reducing dependence on China

item.title: Omar Abdullah Rejects Leadership Speculation, Reaffirms Support for Rahul Gandhi
item.description: Says no talks held on leadership change; backs Rahul Gandhi as LoP

item.title: K.C. Singh | US Court Forces Trump’s Tariff Reset: World In Fix?
item.description: That immediately raised two issues. One, what happens to the almost $100 billion of tariffs already collected by the US government and their likely reimbursement to American importers. Two, the status of the already concluded trade deals, most with higher tariff numbers and one-sided conditions favouring the US?

item.title: Aakar Patel | Targeting Muslims: What ‘Gujarat Model’ Means For The Rise & Rise Of The ‘New India’
item.description: The first element of the Gujarat Model is the political exclusion of Muslims

item.title: AA Edit | To Ensure Oppn Stays United, Congress Should Be Realistic
item.description: The DMK has been holding the Tamil Nadu fort against the saffron assault on its own, but has been graciously accommodating its allies, especially those at the national level

item.title: AA Edit | Peace In Ukraine Will Help Russia Too
item.description: As many as 1.8 million soldiers on both sides are said to have been killed or gone missing in action, with Russia losing 1.2 million soldiers and Ukraine around 600,000
